source_text: Dominus: Equos eorum subnervabis et currus igne combures — ne confidas in equis. Spes nostra Dominus non arma saeculi.
pass_a_gloss: Lord: Horses their you-shall-hamstring and chariots with-fire you-shall-burn — lest you-trust in horses. Hope our Lord not arms of-age.
pass_b_english: The Lord: [[Hamstring their horses and burn their chariots >> Bible:Joshua 11:6]]. Do not trust horses. Our hope is the Lord, not the age’s weapons.
